subject: ACME MAP - final sign-off and go-live confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME MAP - draft and post-demo recap

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks for taking the time today — great discussion and clear alignment on the core success criteria.
Attached is the draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) I mentioned (ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.3.xlsx) and a living Google Doc version here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ACME-MAP-DRAFT

Key milestones in the draft:
- Week 1: Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence (owner: ACME / Redwood support)
- Week 2: Integration sandbox + basic end-to-end test (owner: ACME engineering)
- Week 4: Performance tuning & cost targets validated (owner: Redwood)
- Week 6: Go-live (target)

Ask: please review and confirm owners/target dates for each milestone. If ACME is comfortable with the timeline above, we'll prepare the final MAP for signature and coordinate DocuSign.

Next steps from our side:
- I'll coordinate Redwood's SOC2 artifacts with Vivek and cc you when we have the stubbed evidence.
- Camila will prepare the dedicated capacity proposal and pricing appendix.

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Date: 2026-04-03T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME MAP - draft and post-demo recap

Marissa,

Appreciate the recap and the MAP — clean doc. A few notes from our side after internal sync:
- Security/SOC2: we can provide the required SOC2 evidence by EOD next Tuesday (2026-04-07). Owner: ACME compliance (Priya).
- Integration sandbox: move to Week 3 instead of Week 2 — our engineering bandwidth is tighter than expected.
- Go-live: Tentatively keeping Week 6 but want to set a hard target of 2026-05-15 if the integration hits week 3 timeline.

One ask: can Redwood confirm the SLA we discussed for 99.5% availability and whether that appears in the dedicated capacity appendix? Also need a short note on data residency options for EU customers (we may have multi-region requirements later).

I'll mark the MAP with our comments in the Google Doc. Once you update, Priya and I can sign off and move to signature.

Thanks,
Jordan

Jordan Miles
Senior Product Manager
ACME Corp
jordan.miles@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ACME MAP - draft and post-demo recap (internal follow-up)

Folks — forwarding Jordan's notes. Quick picks:
- SOC2 evidence: Vivek, can you assemble a short bundle (SOC2 summary + selected control evidences) we can share by EOD 2026-04-07? Jordan expects it then.
- Pricing & SLA: Camila, please add the 99.5% SLA language to the Dedicated appendix and include EU data residency as an option (note cost delta).
- Timeline: we'll update MAP to push sandbox to Week 3 and set go-live contingent on successful integration; propose target go-live 2026-05-15 in the doc.

I'll update the Google Doc once we have the SOC2 stub and updated appendix.

-Marissa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: ACME MAP - final draft for sign-off (target go-live 2026-05-15)

Hi Jordan & Priya,

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We've updated the MAP per your notes:
- Sandbox moved to Week 3 (owner: ACME)
- Go-live target set to 2026-05-15 (contingent on integration sign-off)
- Dedicated appendix updated with 99.5% SLA language and EU data residency options (Camila)
- SOC2 evidence bundle attached (SOC2-evidence-stub.pdf) provided by Vivek

Please review the attached final MAP (ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.3.xlsx) and the Google Doc that contains inline comments: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ACME-MAP-DRAFT

Success criteria summary:
1) Integration QA passed in sandbox (ACME)
2) Performance within agreed cost per 1k tokens (Redwood verification)
3) Security review completed with SOC2 artifacts (both)

If everything looks good, please reply with sign-off on the MAP and we'll initiate DocuSign (I will send the agreement and pricing appendix for signature).

Attachments: ACME_Redwood_MAP_v1.3.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-stub.pdf

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Marissa,

Confirming ACME sign-off on the MAP. Priya and I have reviewed the final draft and SOC2 evidence stub — acceptable. We're ready to proceed to signature.

Please send the DocuSign envelope for the MAP + pricing appendix. Also confirming target go-live 2026-05-15 — ACME will prioritize integration testing the week of 2026-04-20.

DocuSign link once envelope is sent would be great; otherwise we will keep an eye out.

Thanks,
Jordan
